note: Daviess County MO (29061) does not publish a queryable county tax parcel service. The only Daviess-specific ArcGIS parcel layer (GDITAdmin 'Parcels - MO - Daviess County' on services.arcgis.com) returns HTTP 400 'Invalid URL' for its metadata and for every query, including the validator's. The county GIS portal (Midland GIS, daviess.integritygis.com) has no arcgis/rest/services directory (404) and no readable links. The assessor site links only to that portal. The gis.mo.gov state-owned parcels layer covers state property, not county tax parcels. Other sources (Regrid, Acres, Rockford Map, AcreValue) are commercial.
